verdict.rationale: Windmill's workspace items are portable. Scripts are plain code in standard languages, flows can be authored in YAML, and Git sync pushes a commit to your own repository on every deploy. The open-source, self-hostable deployment (Docker Compose or Helm) also means you can keep running it on your own infrastructure if you leave the hosted service. However, nothing in the evidence shows a complete data export covering run history, variables/secrets, resources and other workspace state. Missing for 10: a documented full workspace/data export (job history, variables, resources), confirmation that secrets can be exported, and independent hands-on reports of migrating off Windmill.
